excavation_context.character_description: An adult female grad stadent working as a paleontologist, braided black hair, African ethnicity. Wears a white tee shirt worn UNDER a khaki safari vest, white shorts and black hiking boots.
excavation_context.stage: Isolating a Sickle Claw from Brittle Sediments

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_paleontologist_6 uses a fine dental pick to flake away thin layers of a purplish-grey claystone matrix out on a vast, semi-arid floodplain. Her careful strokes reveal the iconic, sharp, highly curved predatory sickle claw of a Deinonychus foot skeleton. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
